command_or_fixture: Read the spec AC-8/AC-9 text; read RENDER_SCRIPT, which stubs context.DialogFrame = ({children}) => h('section', {}, ...children) and so drops the meta prop; read wfds.js Dialog, which renders meta pills; read useDarkMode (data-theme attribute plus localStorage).
counterexample_or_failure_condition: AC-9 can be marked [x] from two arbitrary screenshots without a defined dialog, theme-forcing method, viewport, legibility criterion or network-request observation; AC-8 can pass while the process.track pill still renders.
expected: AC-9 names: which dialog (the longest body), how each theme is forced (data-theme=light/dark on documentElement or the toggle), the viewport widths (desktop and phone width), the legibility pass criteria (no clipped or overflowing text, no horizontal scroll, body text uses theme tokens), the capture tool, and how 'no network request' is observed (request log showing only same-origin requests, with CSP default-src 'self' retained). AC-8 names an assertion on the meta prop passed to DialogFrame (stub captures props.meta) or on the real WFDS Dialog output.
known_bad_detection_method: Readiness review of the plan against the current tree: applied the AC-8 oracle to the current tree (pill present) through the RENDER_SCRIPT DialogFrame stub, which drops meta, so the proposed DOM assertion passes on the known-bad tree; applied AC-9 and found no pass/fail criterion that two arbitrary screenshots would fail. No test was run (suite in progress).
limitations: Inferred from reading code and the spec; no test or browser run (suite in progress in this tree).
observed: AC-9 says only 'screenshots of one dialog in each theme with the dashboard served locally and the network unavailable'; a screenshot cannot show the absence of a network request, and no capture method or pass criterion is stated. AC-8 calls for a 'rendered-DOM assertion', but the harness stub discards meta, so a DOM assertion passes with or without the pill.
proposition: AC-9 (required) has no concrete pass/fail oracle, and the AC-8 oracle as worded would be vacuous against the existing render harness.
